messages:
Nora Kim: Heads-up 52 QuantumRoot flagged by monitoring: weekly active tokens down ~58% and active seats collapsed from 12 -> 3. Saw a note about a PM takeover in CRM.
Samir Patel: yikes. Is this correlated with any infra incidents or releases?
Nora Kim: infra looks clean. Deploy history shows a minor config change two weeks ago but no errors. Drop started 5 days ago.
Evan Lo: any competitor trial intel? last contact mentioned a short POC with VendorX.
Nora Kim: yes PM said they're testing VendorX last Monday.
Caro Jensen: ok so convergence: usage dip + stakeholder handoff + competitive POC = high risk. Recommend we run a focused triage: 1) schedule a 20-min discovery with new PM, 2) pull quick usage and error slices, 3) offer light win (free seats / short trial).
Samir Patel: agree. Can someone pull seat-level activity and last 30 days token trends? Evan?
Evan Lo: on it. SQL IA0use for quick rollup:
```
SELECT date, count(distinct user_id) as active_seats, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM usage.events
WHERE org = 'quantumroot' AND date >= current_date - interval '30 days'
GROUP BY date
ORDER BY date;
```
Evan Lo: running now. No error spike; latency p50/p95 stable. Looks behavioral.
deploy-bot: Meeting scheduled: "QuantumRoot - quick discovery" 2026-04-09 10:30 PT 52 invites: PM, Nora, Caro, Samir.
Caro Jensen: Nora can you draft a 3-line outreach for the PM: 1) quick readout of what we observed, 2) ask about pilot goals w/VendorX, 3) propose a short technical hour or 2x15m sessions to demonstrate quick wins? keep casual.
Nora Kim: Draft sent to thread.
Samir Patel: Pricing/credit thought: propose a 45-day free seat buffer + a one-time migration assist credit if they commit to a 6-month renewal within 60 days. I'll prepare numbers.
Evan Lo: technical checklist: check model routing, KV-cache hit rate, quantization variant in use. I'll also verify there were no silent fallbacks to lower-capacity pool.
Nora Kim: Action list: A) Outreach + agenda (Nora), B) Pricing/credit proposal (Samir), C) Infra/usage slices + brief (Evan), D) One-pager ROI slide (Caro).
Caro Jensen: timeline: outreach today, infra brief by EOD tomorrow, pricing by meeting.
Evan Lo: note: if VendorX POC shows different feature set, be ready to surface migration friction points and one or two feature differentiators.
Nora Kim: pinging PM now with agenda + link to our replay of recent sessions. :mailbox_with_mail:
Samir Patel: thumbs up. keep this high-touch; risk is immediate.
Nora Kim: I'll update after PM reply.
(oncall-bot reaction: :white_check_mark: 1768302599)
